title: Building an Age of Sail game with AI. Just got my clipper fleet sailing through a storm!
author: Novel_Cucumber_1588
selftext:
I'm a solo developer working on an Age of Sail trading and exploration game, inspired by Uncharted Waters Online.

I've been building it in Godot 4 with a lot of help from claude and codex.

Recently, I've been working on the ocean simulation, stormy weather, and fleet sailing mechanics. This clip shows a fleet of clipper ships sailing through a thunderstorm at night.

The ocean uses FFT-based waves with a JONSWAP spectrum, and I've been experimenting with larger swells to make storms feel more convincing.

For the clipper ship model, I gave Sol 6.1 some reference images and asked it to build the ship in Blender. To my surprise, the very first attempt was almost production-ready! I only had to make a few minor adjustments before I could use it in the game. I honestly didn't expect it to turn out that well on the first try.

The long-term goal is a single-player game focused on sailing, trading, exploration, and naval combat.

I was working on the game and thought this particular scene turned out pretty nice, so I figured I'd share it here and show it off a little!

comments.author: Manager-Games145
comments.body: Looks interesting, would love to see where it goes for the full game. what sort of strategy elements are going to be involved?

replies.author: Novel_Cucumber_1588
replies.body: the end goal is to make a single player copy of UWO(unchartered waters online). can do sailing, trading across the world in the 'age of exploration' era. There should be sea battles, exploration elements so that overall the user can play as either a 'merchant/explorer/navy' and switching along whenever they want to. on top of that i hope i can introduce internal/external conflict among major nations that control the ports so that the player can exploit these opportunities for trading benefits.

replies.author: Manager-Games145
replies.body: Yep, Id play that once its released. Really sounds like you have put a lot of effort and thought into it.
